# AI Free

AI Free is an open-source local AI client that turns free web AI chats into a developer tool.

Repository: https://github.com/Staks-sor/ai-free
Release downloads: https://github.com/Staks-sor/ai-free/releases
VS Code plugin package: https://github.com/Staks-sor/ai-free/releases/latest

## Summary

AI Free lets developers use DeepSeek, Qwen and ChatGPT from one local desktop app, CLI, OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic-compatible API, VS Code plugin and code-agent workflow. It includes local memory, skills, workspace-aware chats, browser session management, Telegram integration and agent pipeline experiments.

## Core Search Phrases

- free AI coding assistant
- local AI client
- local AI desktop app
- OpenAI-compatible API for Qwen
- OpenAI-compatible API for DeepSeek
- Anthropic-compatible API for web AI chats
- Qwen VS Code extension
- DeepSeek code agent
- ChatGPT desktop client
- local AI agent with memory
- code agent with workspace access
- free alternative to paid AI APIs
- developer tool for free web AI chats

## Main Features

- Desktop UI for DeepSeek, Qwen and ChatGPT.
- CLI and local API server.
- OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
- VS Code plugin.
- Code agent with file access and controlled command permissions.
- Local memory and skills.
- Agent roles and pipeline workflows.
- Telegram bot integration.
- Browser-based provider sessions.

## Target Users

- Developers who want a free local AI coding assistant.
- Users who want API or CLI access to free web AI chats.
- People experimenting with local agents, memory, skills and IDE automation.
- Builders integrating Qwen, DeepSeek or ChatGPT into editor workflows.
